parent_material.name: M_Bark_Soot (UE side; wraps the trees' bark textures)
parent_material.graph: e = 1.08 - 1.32*Soot; cover = smoothstep(e - 0.08, e + 0.08, SootMask(uv * SootTiling)); BaseColor = lerp(BarkBaseColor, SootColour, cover); Roughness = lerp(BarkRoughness, SootRoughness, cover); Normal = lerp(BarkNormal, FlattenNormal(BarkNormal, 0.5), cover)

params.Soot: scalar 0..1 = SootMoths bark darkness (years().bark / Report bark)
params.SootTiling: scalar (repeats per metre of trunk UV)

mask.format: PNG 8-bit greyscale 512x512, tileable, white = soot settles first

drive: one MID per trunk band, or set Soot each simulated year from SootMoths.years() (it settles at level * (1 - filters * 0.25))
